records.title: Bypassing the Exponential Dependency: Looped Transformers Efficiently Learn In-context by Multi-step Gradient Descent
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.11268. Primary abstract gives a theoretical study of looped-transformer in-context learning on linear tasks; it does not measure deployment inference efficiency.

records.title: InstructRAG: Instructing Retrieval-Augmented Generation with Explicit Denoising
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2406.13629. Primary abstract focuses on denoising retrieved evidence to improve RAG answer accuracy, not reducing inference cost or latency.

records.title: Quantifying the Capabilities of LLMs across Scale and Precision
records.reason: The study supports quantization capability decisions, but does not provide a new inference-efficiency method or direct runtime measurements.

records.title: FABRIC: Personalizing Diffusion Models with Iterative Feedback
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2307.10159. Primary abstract concerns human-feedback personalization for image diffusion models, not LLM inference.

records.title: MoEC: Mixture of Expert Clusters
records.reason: Primary abstract reviewed at https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.09094. Primary abstract addresses MoE overfitting and task quality in machine translation/NLU; its contribution is learning/regularization, not inference efficiency.
